scheme_name: One Time Financial Support for Economically Weaker Meritorious ST Students
other_conditions: The student must have passed Class 10 (Madhyamik) in 2022 with at least 45 % marks for pre‑12th courses, or Class 12 (H.S. level) in 2022 with at least 45 % marks for post‑12th courses.
The student must have taken admission in any professional course listed in Annexure‑A or Annexure‑B during the academic year 2022‑23, with a course duration of at least 2 years.
benefits_summary: One‑time financial support of ₹1,00,000 is provided to eligible students, disbursed in two installments of ₹50,000 each.
